features.name: Animal Speaker
features.desc: You can cast Speak with Animals and Beast Sense as Rituals (without expending a spell slot).

features.name: Rage of the Wilds
features.desc: When you enter a Rage, you choose an animal aspect: Bear (Resistance to every damage type except Force and Psychic), Eagle (Dash and Disengage as a Bonus Action; Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage), or Wolf (allies have Advantage on melee attack rolls against enemies within 5 feet of you). You can change the aspect each time you enter a Rage.

features.name: Aspect of the Wilds
features.desc: A constant sense or movement benefit outside combat (can be changed after a rest): Owl (Darkvision 120 feet), Panther (Climb Speed equal to your Speed), Salmon (Swim Speed equal to your Speed), or Chameleon (Advantage on Stealth checks; you can change your skin color).

features.name: Nature Speaker
features.desc: You can cast Commune with Nature as a Ritual.

features.name: Power of the Wilds
features.desc: Expands your aspect choices when you enter a Rage: Falcon (Fly Speed equal to your Speed while not wearing Heavy armor), Lion (enemies within 5 feet of you have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you), or Ram (when you hit with a melee attack, you can knock a target of Large size or smaller Prone).
